name: GCS
verdict: GCS is Griffin Core Solutions S.L., a small Madrid aerospace company (CIF B06937767) run by its directors Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Sleeve sponsor since 2023-24 (club announcement, 15 September 2023) and in the 2026/27 La Liga sleeve-sponsor table (industry: aerospace). A private Spanish S.L. managed by the two Molina Sanchez directors per the BORME; no state or fund anywhere in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found.
